sources.title: All In Atlanta — weekly games, rules and eligibility

freerolls.title: All In Atlanta: Free Live Poker in Georgia
freerolls.description: Zero-buy-in live Hold’em in Atlanta for players aged 21+. Compare optional bonus-chip promotions and venue prizes before attending.

market.label: Georgia — Atlanta venues
market.note: Local venue games, not US-wide online access.

requirements: Players must be 21+ and physically present.
Check in through Active Games when the host opens registration.
entry.costNote: No purchase is required to enter or win. Optional purchases can earn capped bonus chips during the first five rounds; free alternatives are available.

reward.label: Venue prizes and league points
reward.details: Prizes vary by venue; no fixed cash award is confirmed. Quarterly championships have separate qualification rules.

schedule.text: The organizer advertises Monday and Thursday at Wicked Wolf, and Wednesday at 5 Paces, at 8pm Atlanta time. Confirm operation before travelling; no dated starts are published here.

sections.title: Can I play without buying anything?
sections.text: Yes. A free starting stack and non-purchase bonus-chip options are offered.

sections.title: How do I check the next game?
sections.text: Open the official Active Games section. Check-in opens when the host starts the game.
